bear.text: A news report dated 9 August 2026 states that revenue from operations rose to ₹1,428 crore, a 35% increase from the year-ago period.
The company reported that EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 11.2%, a decrease of 170 basis points from 12.9% in Q1 FY26.
The CFO stated on the earnings call that receivable days increased from 78 to 96 over the last year.

bull.text: The company reported that its order book stood at ₹3,900 crore as of 30 June 2026, up from ₹3,150 crore a year ago.
Management states that the new Bharuch plant, which adds about 30% to cable capacity, is on track to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27.
Exports contributed 21% of revenue in Q1 FY27, an increase from 16% in Q1 FY26.

open_questions.text: The company's press release reports Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹1,248 crore, while a news article reports ₹1,428 crore. What explains this discrepancy between the company's filing and the secondary report?

A March 2024 news article reported promoter pledging at 35%, while the June 2026 exchange filing shows pledging at 4.1% of promoter holding. What explains the difference between these two reported figures?

snapshot.text: Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors.
The company reported profit after tax of ₹82 crore for Q1 FY27, a 5.9% increase from ₹77 crore in Q1 FY26.
As of 30 June 2026, promoters and the promoter group held 58.2% of the company's shares.
